{{- /* An API reference symbol's folded members (api-members.html) in groups by kind, the way TypeDoc and Office.js lay out a type's members: "Property details", then events, methods, the rest. The symbol's own summary tables ("Properties", "Methods") come first on the page; these are the entries they link to. Shared by the HTML page (api-member-sections.html), its table of contents (toc-html.html) and its Markdown version (reference/single.markdown.md), so all three show the same groups under the same anchors. Expects: the symbol's page. Returns a slice of dicts: id (the group heading's anchor), title, members (pages); empty for a page without folded members. */ -}} {{- $members := partial "api-members.html" . -}} {{- $groups := slice -}} {{- $known := slice "property" "event" "method" -}} {{- $defs := slice (dict "kind" "property" "id" "property-details" "title" "Property details") (dict "kind" "event" "id" "event-details" "title" "Event details") (dict "kind" "method" "id" "method-details" "title" "Method details") -}} {{- range $defs -}} {{- $def := . -}} {{- with where $members "Params.kind" $def.kind -}} {{- $groups = $groups | append (dict "id" $def.id "title" $def.title "members" .) -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $rest := slice -}} {{- range $members -}} {{- if not (in $known .Params.kind) }}{{ $rest = $rest | append . }}{{ end -}} {{- end -}} {{- with $rest -}} {{- $groups = $groups | append (dict "id" "member-details" "title" "Member details" "members" .) -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $groups -}}
